title: bash
description: Execute a bash command in a sandboxed or persistent environment, or in background. Restricted to allowed working directories.

command.description: Bash command string to execute (passed to bash -c). Runs in the first allowed directory as working directory.

background.description: If true, run the command asynchronously in background as a job and return job_id immediately.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for persistent terminal session or background job attribution. Reuses persistent bash process across calls.
